summary: Iter 223 — Verified NUMERIC PARITY between the implementer workload-summary tooltip endpoint and the 'Reporte de Carga y Estatus de Proyectos' (workload-pdf) per-implementer totals. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass. (1) Yulimarys Rivas spot check — tooltip returns projects_count=18, cajas_asignadas=205, pvv_asignados=290, exactly matching the report group totals (the originally reported bug 14/171/239 is fixed). (2) GENERAL PARITY across EVERY unambiguous implementer name in /api/projects — all match (projects_count, cajas_asignadas, pvv_asignados equal Nro de Proyectos / Nro de Cajas / Total PVV of the report). (3) Constraints (cajas_pend<=asig, pvv_pend<=asig, 0<=avance<=100, non-negative ints) hold for every implementer. (4) Resilience: nonexistent id+no name -> all zeros, HTTP 200; placeholder uid '_' + name returns same totals as real uid. (5) Data anomaly aggregation: one user (uid user_0aa6077a9fa9) has two name spellings on different projects ('Jhonatan  Rojas' with double space and 'Jonathan Rojas'); the tooltip aggregates these by uid while the report splits them by name string — verified that sum of report groups for that uid equals the tooltip total. Frontend: 90 implementer triggers render; hovering Yulimarys opens popover showing Proyectos 18 / Cajas Asig. 205 · Pend. 170 / PVV Asig. 290 · Pend. 239 / 45% Global. Label is 'Proyectos' (legacy 'Proyectos activos' confirmed absent). Popover closes cleanly on mouseleave.

minor.issue: Projects have inconsistent assigned_to_name spellings for the same user_id (e.g. user_0aa6077a9fa9 appears as both 'Jhonatan  Rojas' (double space) and 'Jonathan Rojas' across different project records). The workload-pdf report groups by name string so this user appears as two rows in the PDF; the tooltip groups by user_id so it aggregates them. Both behaviors are individually correct given their grouping rules, but they will not match per-name in this edge case. Recommended: normalize assigned_to_name when assigning projects, or run a one-shot script to backfill assigned_to_name from the user's canonical full_name keyed by assigned_to_user_id.

cajas_pendientes = max(0, cajas_asignadas - cajas_configuradas) uses _CONFIGURED = {'culminado', 'implementado parcial'} — consistent. Constraint cajas_pend <= cajas_asig confirmed across all implementers.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: implementer_workload_summary previously filtered by 'active' status (excluding Culminado/Anulado), while projects_workload_pdf (the report) counts ALL assigned projects with specific caja/PVV rules. For Yulimarys, tooltip showed 14/171/239 vs report 18/205/290. Fix mirrors the report exactly: NO status filter; cajas_asignadas = Σ _project_total_cajas for quote_type ∈ {VPOS, MPOS, VPOS_MULTIRIF}; pvv_asignados = Σ compute_project_pvv for ALL types. Verified per-implementer parity across the whole dataset.
